claim: For every finite candidate set with at least two alternatives, the rule that minimizes each candidate's largest pairwise defeat margin after excluding Condorcet losers is nonempty and satisfies the Condorcet-winner criterion, Condorcet-loser exclusion, single-voter resolvability, ordinal-margin invariance, and bullet-vote positive involvement; it does not satisfy full positive involvement.

scientific_limitations_integrity.integrity: The proof is self-contained; the full-positive-involvement limitation is checked against published margin lists. No independent audit is claimed.
limitations: The participation guarantee is only for bullet votes, where all non-top alternatives are tied.
The rule does not satisfy full positive involvement; the four-voter transition in the primary source supplies a witness chain.
The 2026 follow-up was inspected at abstract level only.

title: A Minimax Rule for Bullet-Vote Positive Involvement
